WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_net
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, w.net_sales, c.ctrl_net, w.net_sales - c.ctrl_net AS gap
FROM weekly w JOIN ctrl c USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week)
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH rng AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id, f.etl_loaded_at
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
)
SELECT fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl,
       MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM rng GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'closures', store_id, closure_start_date::VARCHAR::INT*0, 0, NULL, NULL, 0 FROM ref_store_closure WHERE 1=0

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.store_id < 900 AND r.receipts > 0 THEN r.store_id END) AS stores_trading,
       SUM(r.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id = 900 THEN r.net_sales END) AS web_net
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 3

SELECT c.*, s.store_name FROM ref_store_closure c LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = c.store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE closure_end_date >= DATE '2025-05-26' AND closure_start_date <= DATE '2026-06-28'
ORDER BY closure_start_date

SELECT 'dup_web_order_ids' AS chk, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS v FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_no_order_or_undispatched', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected') AND o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NOT NULL
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store_lines_matching_web_order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id<>900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_return_lines', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ZZ_test_or_999_in_range_net', COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount),0) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test')

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, MIN(d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS week_start, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ty.week_start AS week_start_this_year, ly.week_start AS week_start_last_year,
       ty.net_sales AS net_sales_this_year, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
